description: Take the most recent published edition back to being the draft, the way out of a page that went out wrong. Its entries are then editable again and it republishes through the normal path. Refuses when a draft is already open (publish or discard that first) and when the edition is not the latest (older ones have permalinks readers may have linked and a number the sequence depends on). The public page stays on. Audited. Requires the MANAGER role or above.

editionId.description: Changelog edition id (uuid): get_changelog returns these
